title: Old School Dark Mode
description: A collection of dark mode texturepacks for different older versions/mods/modpacks
body:
This is a collection of dark mode texturepacks for older versions/mods/modpacks Mods such as:
- Voxels In Time
- Not So Seecret Saturday
- ReIndev
- Better Than Wolves: Community Edition
- _and more.._ Based on Laine The Tran Can's BTA Dark Mode pack, which you can find [here!](https://discord.com/channels/866992171319558144/1343012650543616122)
